with_sera.speaker: sera
with_sera.text: The roll. Every name on the Ninth Stair, in the purge clerk's hand. I want to read them. All of them. Out loud. Here.

choices.text: Read them. We will stand here as long as it takes.
Give it to me. I will carry it to the Ashfound; they will answer for it.
Burn it. Names are ash already.

read.speaker: sera
read.text: Two hundred and eleven. The last one was a child called Wren. I am done. Thank you for standing there.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A purge roll in a clerk's hand. Two hundred and eleven names. Nobody here to read them.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: The roll Sera wanted to read. Two hundred and eleven names, and one more now, in your hand.
